shortDescription: 81 Windows controls you can read before you apply. Every change is previewed, recorded and reversible, with a live PC Health dashboard, a 13-check Scan and a clearer Debloat.
description:
PC Tweaker gives you 81 Windows controls (46 Free, 35 Pro) for performance, gaming, privacy and everyday use. Every control shows exactly what it will write before anything changes, and records the previous value so you can put it back.

PREVIEW BEFORE YOU APPLY
Open "What this changes, exactly" on any control to see each registry key or setting, the value it holds now and the value it will be set to, read from your PC without changing anything. If an application fails partway, the values already written are restored immediately.

WINDOWS UPDATES WITHOUT SURPRISES
With "Watch for Windows updates" on, PC Tweaker checks at sign-in and tells you only when something has actually stopped being in effect. You get a list with one checkbox per control: untick anything you changed on purpose and re-apply the rest. Nothing is re-applied on its own.

THE WINDOWS AI FEATURES, YOUR CALL
Controls for Click to Do (where Windows offers it), the Windows AI Fabric service and the AI features in Microsoft Edge, Paint and Notepad. Each card states what it needs: user or machine scope, administrator rights, Windows version and edition. A control that does not apply to your PC says so.

PC HEALTH, LIVE
Processor load per core, memory in use, cached and free, disk and network activity, and what is using resources, grouped by app from Windows' own process list, over 1 or 5 minutes. Graphics load, temperature, fan and video memory on NVIDIA graphics cards. Missing sensors are reported, not guessed. The Health Score rates your PC in nine areas, and every point comes from something measurable on your machine.

SCAN, DEBLOAT AND GAMING
Scan runs 13 checks and can be paused, resumed or ended; ending early keeps a partial result that names the checks that did not run. Debloat groups the apps on your PC by kind with their real size and explains what you lose before anything is removed. Nothing is selected for you. Turbo Boost shows measured processor load, clock speeds and a fixed 3-second test, so you can compare modes with numbers.

BEFORE & AFTER AND A COMPLETE CHANGE HISTORY
Measure on PC Health, apply your changes and measure again: each timed test runs at least 7 times, and a difference is reported only when the two series are clearly apart and at least 5% apart. Change history shows every change by day and session, where it came from and the registry values before and after. Undo one change, a session or everything still in effect, always after a confirmation, and export the history to CSV or JSON.

WITH PRO
35 more controls, app priority rules (never above High), a weekly cleanup of temporary files to the Recycle Bin, Secure Defragmentation, Zero-Trace Cleaner, a click-through gaming overlay, Driver Booster and thermal profiles.

FREE AND PRO: WHAT YOU PAY FOR
PC Tweaker is free to download, and the Free plan has no time limit: the 46 Free controls and everything else not marked Pro keep working for as long as you use the app, with no trial period and no expiry.
Pro is optional. You buy it inside the app with a PC Tweaker account, and payment opens in your browser on a secure Stripe checkout, not through the Microsoft Store. Prices: €7.99 a month, €59.99 a year, or €99 once for Lifetime, excluding VAT, which is added at checkout where it applies. Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically until you cancel; after cancelling, Pro stays active until the end of the period you paid for, then the app returns to the Free plan. Changes already applied stay in place and can still be undone.
Free trial of Pro: the monthly and yearly plans can start with a 3-day free trial, once per account. A card or another payment method accepted by Stripe is saved at checkout and nothing is charged until the trial ends; then the plan's price is charged automatically and the subscription begins. Cancel before the end of the trial from Plans & pricing, Manage subscription, and nothing is charged. If the first payment fails, Pro is suspended until a payment succeeds and the app returns to the Free plan. The trial is optional: Subscribe now starts the plan with no trial and the price is charged on the day. Lifetime has no trial.
Limited-time discounts, such as a seasonal offer, are shown in the app with a countdown to their end; on monthly and yearly plans they cover the first month or year only, and renewals are at the regular price. The optional "Buy me a coffee" tip (€1 per coffee, up to 10) unlocks nothing.

Six languages: English, Italian, French, Spanish, German and Portuguese. Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. The Windows binaries are signed by Aurelio Avila.

releaseNotes:
PC Tweaker 1.18.13 puts the 3-day free trial in plain sight.

- The title bar offers "Start 3-day free trial" on every screen while your account can still start one, and shows the days left while it runs.
- After a scan, the Pro recommendations offer the same free trial.
- On short windows, down to the smallest size, the whole menu stays on screen in every language.
- Still 81 controls (46 Free, 35 Pro).

Settings, licenses and the change history are kept.
